plugin_asdk_app_69c28d6aedac81919502a88c.longDescription:
Play chess without leaving ChatGPT. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that they happened. Every game becomes a chance to get stronger.

You can also practice specific parts of chess. Focus on openings you want to remember. Study endgames that appear often. Learn how to attack, defend, trade pieces, or make better plans. Ask for tips that match your current skill level instead of getting the same advice every player receives.

The conversation is just as important as the game. Ask “What if I move here?” Ask “What was my best move?” Ask “Why did my attack fail?” Ask “Can you explain that in a simpler way?” The app is built for questions, so you are never limited to playing in silence.

There is no need to switch between different tools just to play and learn. The chessboard and the conversation work together. You make a move, ask a question, get an answer, and keep playing. Everything happens in one place, making practice smooth and enjoyable.

Whether you play one game a week or many games every day, the app is ready. Beginners can build confidence. Casual players can have fun. Club players can explore ideas. Anyone who enjoys chess can have interesting conversations while playing.

Use the app to play complete games, test new ideas, understand difficult positions, review finished games, and discover better moves. Learn at your own pace. Stay curious. Ask as many questions as you like. Every move is another chance to think, learn, and enjoy the game. If you want a chess game that also talks with you, teaches you, and helps you improve inside ChatGPT, this app is ready to play.
plugin_asdk_app_69c28d6aedac81919502a88c.longDescriptionZh:
无需离开 ChatGPT 即可下棋。在几秒钟内开始新游戏，用正常的国际象棋语言走棋，并在玩游戏时谈论游戏的每个部分。你可以问为什么一个动作是好的，为什么一个动作是坏的，下一步该做什么，或者如何变得更好。这个应用程序是为那些想要同时玩耍、学习和享受乐趣的人而设计的。

该应用程序易于使用。只需开始游戏并采取行动即可。您可以使用简单的棋步名称、标准国际象棋符号，或用简单的英语提问。如果您不确定该怎么做，请寻求帮助。游戏在您聊天的同时继续进行，因此学习感觉很自然，而不是像阅读冗长的课程。

如果您是国际象棋新手，那么这个应用程序是一个友好的起点。它通过小而简单的步骤解释了想法。它告诉您每个棋子可以做什么以及为什么某些动作比其他动作更强。你永远不必假装你理解。再问一个问题吧。您一次可以学习一个动作。

如果您已经知道如何玩，则可以更深入。谈论开局、中局、残局、战术、策略、计划和常见错误。询问为什么某一立场对一方感觉更好。比较不同的动作。探索新想法。对话内容会根据您的问题进行更改。

按照你自己的速度玩。长时间思考或快速行动。停下来询问职位。返回并查看之前的动作。尝试不同的想法，看看会发生什么。国际象棋不仅仅是寻找最佳走法。它还涉及理解这一举​​措为何有效。

该应用程序可以使用清晰的语言解释叉子、别针、串、发现的攻击、双重检查、牺牲​​、通过的棋子、国王的安全、棋子的活动、空间、时间和许多其他国际象棋思想。困难的话题变得更容易，因为您可以在需要时要求另一种解释。

想要改进吗？游戏结束后进行回顾。谈论转折点、错失的机会和强有力的举措。询问游戏在哪里发生了变化。在你的游戏中寻找模式。从错误中吸取教训，而不是仅仅看到错误的发生。每场比赛都成为变得更强的机会。

您还可以练习国际象棋的特定部分。专注于你想要记住的空缺。研究经常出现的残局。学习如何攻击、防御、交易碎片或制定更好的计划。寻求与您当前技能水平相匹配的提示，而不是为每个玩家提供相同的建议。
对话和游戏一样重要。问“如果我搬到这里怎么办？”问“我最好的举动是什么？”问“为什么我的攻击失败了？”问“你能用更简单的方式解释一下吗？”该应用程序专为提问而设计，因此您永远不会局限于安静地玩。

无需在不同工具之间切换即可玩耍和学习。棋盘和对话一起发挥作用。你采取行动，提出问题，得到答案，然后继续玩。一切都发生在一个地方，使练习变得顺利和愉快。

无论您每周玩一款游戏还是每天玩很多游戏，该应用程序都已准备就绪。初学者可以建立信心。休闲玩家也能玩得开心。俱乐部球员可以探索想法。任何喜欢下棋的人都可以在下棋时进行有趣的对话。

使用该应用程序玩完整的游戏，测试新想法，了解困难的位置，回顾已完成的游戏，并发现更好的动作。按照自己的节奏学习。保持好奇心。你想问多少问题就问多少。每一步都是思考、学习和享受游戏的另一个机会。如果您想要一款能够在 ChatGPT 中与您对话、教您并帮助您提高的国际象棋游戏，那么这个应用程序就可以玩了。

plugin_asdk_app_69a8532b7a3c81918652609a.productIntro: 在一个简单的地方关注每一场比赛。这款 ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您查看赛程、实时比分、结果、联赛表和球队详细信息，而无需在许多网站之间跳转。选择您的联赛，选择您最喜欢的俱乐部，并快速找到您想要的比赛和信息。一切都以干净、易于阅读的视图呈现，因此您可以花更多的时间享受足球，而减少搜索的时间。
plugin_asdk_app_69a8532b7a3c81918652609a.productIntroEn: Follow every match in one simple place. This ChatGPT app helps you see fixtures, live scores, results, league tables, and team details without jumping between lots of websites. Pick your league, choose your favorite club, and quickly find the games and information you want.
plugin_asdk_app_69a8532b7a3c81918652609a.longDescription:
Follow every match in one simple place. This ChatGPT app helps you see fixtures, live scores, results, league tables, and team details without jumping between lots of websites. Pick your league, choose your favorite club, and quickly find the games and information you want. Everything is laid out in a clean, easy-to-read view so you can spend more time enjoying football and less time searching for it.

The app is made for everyone. You do not need to know football statistics or understand complicated menus. If you only want to know who is playing today, you can. If you want to check how your team is doing in the league, you can do that too. Every screen is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to understand.

Browse competitions from around the world, including the biggest leagues and tournaments. Select a competition to see the current standings, upcoming fixtures, completed matches, and club information. Change leagues with a tap and instantly see new results. Whether you support one team or follow many competitions, the app keeps everything together in one place.

Choose any team to make the experience even more personal. When you select a club, you can quickly find its upcoming matches, recent results, and position in the table. No more scrolling through pages filled with teams you do not follow. The app helps you focus on the football that matters most to you.

The league table is clear and easy to read. See each club’s position, matches played, wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference at a glance. Tables update as results change, making it simple to keep track of the season. Whether your team is chasing the title, fighting for Europe, or trying to avoid relegation, you can see where they stand in seconds.

Match information is presented in a clean and organized way. Check who is playing, when the match starts, and how the game ended once it is finished. Live scores and completed results are easy to follow, helping you stay connected even when you cannot watch the match.

The simple design works well on different screen sizes and keeps distractions to a minimum. Clear navigation makes moving between competitions, teams, and matches feel natural. Large text, familiar football icons, and organized tables make information easy to find for both new and experienced fans.

Because the app runs inside ChatGPT, you can also ask questions naturally. Instead of searching through menus, you can ask about a team’s recent matches, league position, or upcoming fixtures. ChatGPT helps you find answers quickly while the app presents the information in a structured format.

Whether you follow football every day or only check scores on weekends, this app saves time. It brings together fixtures, results, standings, and team information in one place so you always know what is happening. It is useful before a match, during the action, and after the final whistle.

Key features include:

* Easy competition selection.
* Team filtering for faster browsing.
* Live scores and finished match results.
* Upcoming fixtures.
* League tables with wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference.
* Clean, simple interface.
* Fast navigation between competitions and clubs.
* Natural language support through ChatGPT.

From the first match of the season to the last, this app makes following football simple. Open it, choose a league, pick a team, and see the information you need in just a few taps. Whether you support a local club, a Premier League giant, or teams from leagues around the world, this app keeps football easy to follow, easy to understand, and always close at hand.
plugin_asdk_app_69a8532b7a3c81918652609a.longDescriptionZh:
在一个简单的地方关注每一场比赛。这款 ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您查看赛程、实时比分、结果、联赛表和球队详细信息，而无需在许多网站之间跳转。选择您的联赛，选择您最喜欢的俱乐部，并快速找到您想要的比赛和信息。一切都以干净、易于阅读的视图呈现，因此您可以花更多的时间享受足球，而减少搜索的时间。

该应用程序是为每个人设计的。您不需要了解足球统计数据或了解复杂的菜单。如果您只想知道今天谁在比赛，您可以。如果您想查看您的球队在联赛中的表现，您也可以这样做。每个屏幕都设计得简单、快速且易于理解。

浏览世界各地的比赛，包括最大的联赛和锦标赛。选择一场比赛即可查看当前排名、即将举行的比赛、已完成的比赛和俱乐部信息。只需轻按即可更改联赛并立即查看新结果。无论您支持一支球队还是关注多场比赛，该应用程序都能将所有内容集中在一处。

选择任意团队，让体验更加个性化。当您选择一个俱乐部时，您可以快速找到其即将举行的比赛、最近的成绩以及在表格中的位置。不再需要滚动浏览充满您不关注的团队的页面。该应用程序可帮助您专注于对您最重要的足球。

排行榜清晰易读。一目了然地查看每个俱乐部的排名、比赛场数、胜、平、负、积分和净胜球。表格随着结果的变化而更新，让跟踪赛季变得简单。无论您的球队是在追逐冠军、为欧洲而战，还是试图避免降级，您都可以在几秒钟内了解他们的处境。

比赛信息以干净、有组织的方式呈现。查看谁在比赛、比赛何时开始以及比赛结束后如何结束。实时比分和完整结果易于查看，即使您无法观看比赛，也能帮助您保持联系。

简单的设计适用于不同的屏幕尺寸，并将干扰降至最低。清晰的导航让在比赛、团队和比赛之间移动变得自然。大文本、熟悉的足球图标和井井有条的表格使新球迷和经验丰富的球迷都能轻松找到信息。
由于该应用程序在 ChatGPT 内部运行，因此您也可以自然地提出问题。您无需搜索菜单，而是可以询问球队最近的比赛、联赛排名或即将举行的比赛。 ChatGPT 可帮助您快速找到答案，同时应用程序以结构化格式呈现信息。

无论您每天关注足球还是仅在周末查看比分，此应用程序都可以节省时间。它将赛程、结果、排名和球队信息汇集到一处，以便您始终了解正在发生的事情。它在比赛前、比赛期间和终场哨响后都很有用。

主要特点包括：

* 轻松的比赛选择。
* 团队过滤以加快浏览速度。
* 实时比分和最终比赛结果。
* 即将举行的赛程。
* 联赛表包含胜、平、负、积分和净胜球。
* 干净、简单的界面。

plugin_asdk_app_69ffb5641b108191867408bc.productIntroEn: Chess by Max Health lets people play and study chess inside ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_69ffb5641b108191867408bc.longDescription: Chess by Max Health lets people play and study chess inside ChatGPT. Players can start a single-player game against the built-in Stockfish engine at a chosen difficulty (Beginner to Maximum) or against the conversation model, with selectable color and time controls, and can join a live multiplayer lobby to play other people (with optional ranked ELO and match history for signed-in Max Health users). The same Stockfish engine analyzes games: per-move accuracy, blunders and inaccuracies, the turning points, and the time spent on each move, shown on an interactive board the user can step through. Games to analyze can come from the current session, a signed-in user's stored matches, or any public chess.com or Lichess username fetched live. Single positions can also be evaluated for the best move and main line, and key positions can be illustrated on a board with the recommended move and an evaluation bar.

plugin_asdk_app_69987133a2e0819186859d05.productIntroEn: Find hidden words, have fun every day, and give your brain a happy workout. Our Word Search game is easy to play, relaxing, and full of exciting puzzles for every age. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. plugin_asdk_app_69987133a2e0819186859d05.longDescription:
Find hidden words, have fun every day, and give your brain a happy workout. Our Word Search game is easy to play, relaxing, and full of exciting puzzles for every age. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. Play at home, on the bus, during a break, or before bed. There is always a new puzzle waiting for you.

Each puzzle is filled with hidden words. Look across, down, up, backward, or diagonal to find them all. Tap or drag across the letters to mark each word. Finish the list to solve the puzzle and move on to the next challenge. The controls are simple, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

There are puzzles for beginners and experts. Start with easy games or test yourself with harder challenges. As you play, you will spot words faster, learn new words, and build your confidence. Every completed puzzle feels rewarding and keeps you coming back for one more game.

Choose from many fun topics. Search for animals, food, nature, space, sports, travel, music, holidays, science, colors, jobs, and much more. Every theme brings a fresh collection of words to discover, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.

Play whenever you want, even without an internet connection. This makes the game perfect for travel, waiting rooms, flights, road trips, camping, or anywhere you want quiet entertainment. Your next puzzle is always ready.

Need a little help? Use hints if you get stuck. They point you in the right direction so you can keep having fun without feeling frustrated. Whether you are learning or challenging yourself, hints make every puzzle enjoyable.

The clean design is easy on your eyes. Bright letters, smooth controls, and clear layouts make finding words simple and comfortable. Play for a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions without distractions.

Word Search is more than a game. It is a relaxing way to exercise your mind. Finding hidden words helps improve focus, attention, spelling, vocabulary, and pattern recognition while keeping gameplay calm and enjoyable. Many players enjoy using word searches to unwind after a busy day.

There is no rush unless you want one. Take your time and enjoy every puzzle, or challenge yourself to finish as quickly as possible. Play your way and set your own pace.

The game is designed for everyone. Children can practice reading and spelling. Teens can sharpen their vocabulary. Adults can relax after work. Seniors can enjoy gentle brain exercise while having fun. Families can even play together and see who finds the most words.

New puzzles and fresh challenges help keep the adventure going. With so many word lists and themes, there is always something different to discover. You can play again and again without running out of fun.

Why players love Word Search:
• Thousands of fun word search puzzles.
• Easy to learn and simple to play.
• Great for kids, adults, and seniors.
• Multiple difficulty levels.
• Fun themed word packs.
• Relaxing gameplay.
• Helpful hints when needed.
• Play online or offline.
• Quick games or long play sessions.
• Smooth controls and clean design.
• Great for improving vocabulary.
• Exercises your brain while you play.
• Perfect for daily play.
• Suitable for beginners and experienced players.

If you enjoy word games, brain games, spelling games, hidden object puzzles, or relaxing puzzle games, this is the perfect choice. Download today and start your next word search adventure. Find hidden words, complete every puzzle, improve your vocabulary, challenge your mind, and enjoy hours of relaxing fun. Your next favorite word search game is ready whenever you are.
plugin_asdk_app_69987133a2e0819186859d05.longDescriptionZh:
找到隐藏的单词，享受每一天，让你的大脑得到快乐的锻炼。我们的单词搜索游戏玩法简单、轻松，并且充满了适合各个年龄段的令人兴奋的谜题。无论您有几分钟还是一整个下午，您都可以随时享受数千个单词的搜索。在家里、在公共汽车上、休息时或睡觉前玩。总有新的谜题等着你。

每个谜题都充满了隐藏的单词。横向、向下、向上、向后或对角线看，都能找到它们。点击或拖动字母来标记每个单词。完成列表以解决难题并继续下一个挑战。控制很简单，所以任何人都可以在几秒钟内开始玩。

这里有适合初学者和专家的谜题。从简单的游戏开始，或者通过更困难的挑战来测试自己。当你玩的时候，你会更快地认出单词、学习新单词并建立你的信心。每一个完成的谜题都会让你感觉很有价值，并让你想再玩一局。

从许多有趣的主题中进行选择。搜索动物、食物、自然、太空、运动、旅行、音乐、假期、科学、颜色、工作等等。每个主题都带来了新的单词集合供您发现，让每个谜题都感觉新颖且令人兴奋。

即使没有互联网连接，您也可以随时玩。这使得该游戏非常适合旅行、候机室、航班、公路旅行、露营或任何您想要安静娱乐的地方。您的下一个拼图随时准备就绪。

需要一点帮助吗？如果遇到困难，请使用提示。他们为您指明了正确的方向，这样您就可以继续享受乐趣而不会感到沮丧。无论您是在学习还是在挑战自己，提示都会让每个谜题变得有趣。

简洁的设计让您的眼睛感到舒适。明亮的字母、流畅的控制和清晰的布局使查找单词变得简单而舒适。不受干扰地玩几分钟或享受更长时间的游戏。

单词搜索不仅仅是一个游戏。这是锻炼思维的一种放松方式。找到隐藏的单词有助于提高专注力、注意力、拼写、词汇和模式识别能力，同时保持游戏过程的平静和愉快。许多玩家喜欢在忙碌的一天后使用单词搜索来放松。

除非你想要，否则不着急。慢慢来，享受每一个谜题，或者挑战自己尽快完成。按照您的方式进行游戏并设定您自己的节奏。
该游戏是为每个人设计的。孩子们可以练习阅读和拼写。青少年可以提高词汇量。大人下班后可以放松一下。老年人可以在玩乐的同时享受温和的大脑锻炼。家人甚至可以一起玩，看看谁找到最多的单词。

新的谜题和新的挑战有助于让冒险继续下去。有如此多的单词列表和主题，总有一些不同的东西有待发现。您可以一次又一次地玩，而不会失去乐趣。

为什么玩家喜欢单词搜索：
• 数以千计的有趣的单词搜索谜题。
• 易学易玩。
• 非常适合儿童、成人和老年人。
• 多个难度级别。
• 有趣的主题单词包。
• 轻松的游戏体验。
• 需要时提供有用的提示。
• 在线或离线玩。
• 快速游戏或长时间游戏。
• 流畅的控制和简洁的设计。
• 非常适合提高词汇量。
• 在玩耍时锻炼大脑。
• 非常适合日常玩耍。
• 适合初学者和有经验的玩家。

如果您喜欢文字游戏、益智游戏、拼写游戏、隐藏物体谜题或轻松的益智游戏，那么这是您的完美选择。立即下载并开始您的下一个单词搜索冒险。找到隐藏的单词，完成每个谜题，提高词汇量，挑战你的思维，享受数小时的轻松乐趣。您的下一个最喜欢的单词搜索游戏随时准备就绪。

plugin_asdk_app_697aeaf3d1a881919418b915.longDescription:
Radio FM – Internet Radio and Podcasts

Radio FM is a mobile application for listening to internet radio stations and podcasts from around the world. It provides access to a wide range of audio content, including music, news, talk shows, and entertainment programs.

You can browse and stream radio stations from different countries and explore podcasts across multiple categories and languages.

Content उपलब्ध (Available Content)

Radio stations from various countries and regions
Podcasts across categories such as news, music, talk shows, and entertainment
Multiple genres including classical, rock, pop, hip-hop, instrumental, and more

Key Features

Browse radio stations by country
Search for specific radio stations or podcasts
Save stations and podcasts to a favorites list
View recently played stations
Sleep timer to automatically stop playback
Alarm feature to start playback at a scheduled time
Access podcasts by category
Simple and easy-to-use interface
Playback controls from notifications
Option to start playback when the app opens

Device Support
Radio FM is compatible with Android Auto, Google Chromecast, Android TV, and wearable devices.

Radio Station Access
The app includes thousands of radio stations added by broadcasters worldwide. New stations may be added over time. If a station is not available, users can suggest it through the app.

Support and Feedback
For help or questions, visit: http://appradiofm.com/faq-list/

Contact: support@appRadioFM.com

您可以浏览和流式传输来自不同国家/地区的广播电台，并探索多个类别和语言的播客。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2eb9773400819196dedd53.description: 玩耍+学习/教练/策略+技巧
plugin_asdk_app_6a2eb9773400819196dedd53.longDescription:
Play Checkers inside ChatGPT!

Turn any chat into a live checkers match. This app brings the classic strategy game directly into your conversation, letting you start a new game in seconds, make moves naturally through chat, and watch the board update as you play.

Whether you’re looking for a quick casual game, a challenging strategic battle, or a way to sharpen your tactical thinking, the app makes checkers feel effortless and interactive. Play against ChatGPT, test new openings, practice endgame techniques, or challenge yourself with increasingly difficult positions.

Features

* Instant gameplay directly inside the conversation
* Interactive game board that updates after every move
* Play against ChatGPT at your own pace
* Ask the AI for move suggestions and strategy tips for learning and improvement
* Start fresh or load custom positions for practice
* No downloads, accounts, or setup required

From beginners learning the basics to experienced players refining their tactics, this app transforms a simple chat into an engaging, competitive experience. Open a game, make your move, and see if you have what it takes to outmaneuver your opponent and claim victory!
plugin_asdk_app_6a2eb9773400819196dedd53.longDescriptionZh:
在 ChatGPT 中玩跳棋！

将任何聊天变成现场跳棋比赛。该应用程序将经典策略游戏直接带入您的对话中，让您在几秒钟内开始新游戏，通过聊天自然地进行移动，并在玩游戏时观看棋盘更新。

无论您是在寻找快速休闲游戏、具有挑战性的战略战斗，还是提高战术思维的方法，该应用程序都能让跳棋感觉轻松且具有互动性。与 ChatGPT 比赛，测试新的开局，练习残局技巧，或用越来越困难的局面挑战自己。

特点

* 直接在对话中进行即时游戏
* 每次移动后都会更新的互动游戏板
* 按照您自己的节奏与 ChatGPT 比赛
* 向人工智能询问移动建议和学习和改进的策略提示
* 开始新的或加载自定义位置进行练习
* 无需下载、帐户或设置

从学习基础知识的初学者到完善战术的经验丰富的玩家，该应用程序将简单的聊天转变为引人入胜的竞争体验。打开游戏，采取行动，看看你是否有能力智取对手并取得胜利！

plugin_asdk_app_694340f300d481918bb288b9.longDescription:
Discover your next favorite Steam game with AI-powered search and review analysis. 

Search over 120,000 Steam games using natural language — just describe what you're looking for ("cozy farming games" or "challenging roguelikes with great soundtrack") and browse results with trailers, screenshots, and pricing.

Get instant AI summaries of Steam reviews that distill thousands of player opinions into clear insights about what works and what doesn't. Filter by sentiment, playtime, and language.

Explore deeper analytics across 4.3M roguelite game reviews to see how player sentiment evolves over playtime, compare top titles, and search what players actually say about specific topics like "difficulty," "multiplayer," or "replayability."

All data comes directly from Steam, no web searches, just real player feedback.

探索对 430 万个 Roguelite 游戏评论的更深入分析，了解玩家情绪在游戏时间内的变化情况，比较热门游戏，并搜索玩家对“难度”、“多人游戏”或“可重玩性”等特定主题的实际看法。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5e73d0587c8191bec1161c.productIntroEn: Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e73d0587c8191bec1161c.longDescription:
Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. Find out what other movies an actor has been in. Explore the work of a director. Jump from one movie to another without starting a new search.

The app is great for quick questions too. See when a movie came out. See who stars in it. See who directed it. See how long it is. See what it is about before you decide to watch it. Everything stays inside your chat, making it easy to keep exploring.

If you enjoy learning about film, this app is a fun way to discover connections. See actors in different movies. See famous directors. Find movie series and collections. Compare different films. Learn about old classics and brand-new releases. Every question can lead to another interesting discovery.

The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this ChatGPT app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e73d0587c8191bec1161c.longDescriptionZh:
查找电影应该很容易。这款 ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您发现、探索和了解电影，而无需离开对话。询问几乎所有电影并在一处获得清晰的信息。无论您已经知道自己想要什么，还是只是想要电影之夜的创意，这个应用程序都能让一切变得简单。不用打开很多网站一遍又一遍地搜索，你可以用简单的语言询问并继续聊天。感觉自然、快速且有趣。

一旦找到一部电影，您就可以了解更多信息。查看故事、主要演员、导演、发行年份、运行时间和其他有用的详细信息。了解每个角色的扮演者。了解演员还出演过哪些其他电影。探索导演的作品。从一部电影跳到另一部电影，无需开始新的搜索。

该应用程序也非常适合快速提问。看看电影什么时候上映。看看都有哪些明星出演。看看是谁导演的。看看它有多长。在决定观看之前先了解一下它的内容。所有内容都保留在您的聊天中，让您可以轻松地继续探索。

如果您喜欢学习电影，这个应用程序是发现联系的有趣方式。查看不同电影中的演员。见著名导演。查找电影系列和收藏。比较不同的电影。了解旧经典和全新版本。每个问题都可以带来另一个有趣的发现。

该应用程序非常适合休闲电影迷和电影爱好者。您不需要了解电影琐事或记住确切的名字。就自然地问吧。对话会继续进行，因此您可以提出后续问题而不必重复自己。这使得探索电影变得顺畅而简单。

一切都是为了帮助您花更少的时间搜索，而有更多的时间欣赏电影。您无需在页面之间跳转，而是可以在一个地方浏览、发现、比较和学习。这是通过自然对话探索电影世界的简单方法。

无论您想要下一部最喜欢的电影、有关经典的信息、有关新版本的详细信息，还是帮助记住多年前的电影，这款 ChatGPT 应用程序都可以为您提供帮助。提出简单的问题，进行更深入的探索，并通过一次对话来享受发现电影的乐趣。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4629026ee08191ba905d74.longDescription:
Pitch 1024 hands you a reference pitch sung by a real musician — not a synthesized beep. Ask for a note, a voiced chord, starting pitches for any key, or a full chord progression, and tap the card to hear it, in the voice of the musician you choose from a cast of six.

Build a chord with several voices harmonizing together — in stereo, or in full 3D around you on headphones — pass a progression around the ensemble one singer per chord, or drill your ear with hidden-answer note, interval, and chord-quality quizzes.

Useful for singers warming up, a cappella groups finding their starting pitches, instrumentalists tuning by ear, and anyone who'd rather match a real voice than a tone generator.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4629026ee08191ba905d74.longDescriptionZh:

用多个声音和谐地构建一个和弦 - 立体声或通过耳机在您周围的全 3D 环境中 - 每个和弦一位歌手在合奏中传递一个进程，或者通过隐藏答案音符、音程和和弦质量测验来钻你的耳朵。

plugin_asdk_app_6a72d5743ab481918bff8de4.productIntro: 与人工智能对手玩德州扑克，然后与 ChatGPT 讨论每一手牌。这不仅仅是一场扑克游戏。这是一个玩耍、学习、提问和一次提升一只手的地方。如果您是扑克新手，人工智能可以帮助您了解正在发生的事情。如果您已经了解游戏，则可以测试想法、尝试新计划并审查您的选择。每场比赛都成为学习的机会。
plugin_asdk_app_6a72d5743ab481918bff8de4.productIntroEn: Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices.
plugin_asdk_app_6a72d5743ab481918bff8de4.longDescription:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.
plugin_asdk_app_6a72d5743ab481918bff8de4.longDescriptionZh:
与人工智能对手玩德州扑克，然后与 ChatGPT 讨论每一手牌。这不仅仅是一场扑克游戏。这是一个玩耍、学习、提问和一次提升一只手的地方。如果您是扑克新手，人工智能可以帮助您了解正在发生的事情。如果您已经了解游戏，则可以测试想法、尝试新计划并审查您的选择。每场比赛都成为学习的机会。

您只需几分钟就可以坐下来开始玩。游戏遵循德州扑克规则。发牌、下注，每一手牌都像真正的游戏一样进行。当牌局结束时，您可以询问 ChatGPT 为什么发生了什么事。询问为什么下注是好的，为什么弃牌是明智的，或者为什么诈唬有效。你可以继续问，直到有道理为止。

学习扑克并不一定会感到困难。大的想法是用小而简单的词语来解释的。如果你不知道翻牌圈、转牌圈、河牌圈或盲注是什么，尽管问。如果您想知道底池赔率是什么意思，请询问。如果您需要帮助阅读牌面或在跟注、加注或弃牌之间进行选择，请询问。人工智能以清晰友好的方式解释每一步。

你可以自由地按照你想要的方式玩。尝试安全游戏。尝试大胆的玩法。多虚张声势。少虚张声势。看看会发生什么。如果事情进展顺利，就问为什么。如果出现问题，请询问下次可以做什么。每一个选择都是学习新东西的机会。

这不仅适合初学者。经验丰富的玩家可以探索策略、比较想法并思考难点。谈论手牌范围、位置、价值下注、听牌和抓诈唬。询问还有哪些其他可能的线路。询问不同的玩家可能会做什么。对话可以按照您的意愿进行深入。

不着急。每次行动前都要花点时间。想想你的卡。看看黑板。考虑一下你的对手可能有什么。然后决定。牌局结束后，谈谈结果。学习发生在每场比赛之前、期间和之后。

由于 ChatGPT 是体验的一部分，因此每次会话都可能有所不同。您可以提出简单的问题或困难的问题。您可以要求简短的答案或更长的课程。你甚至可以要求人工智能像你五岁一样解释事情。游戏会随着你的技能水平而增长。
使用这个应用程序进行练习，没有真正的扑克桌的压力。尝试你以前从未测试过的想法。犯错误。向他们学习。一步步建立信心。扑克是一项需要技巧、耐心和良好决策的游戏，练习可以帮助每个玩家提高水平。

无论您是想在休息时快速玩游戏，还是想花更长的时间来学习策略，这个应用程序都已准备就绪。玩几手。玩一场完整的游戏。只要你愿意，就停下来问问题。每一次对话都可以帮助您更好地理解游戏。

如果您喜欢让您思考的游戏，如果您想提高德州扑克水平，或者您只是想用可以解释其思维的人工智能来玩扑克，那么这个应用程序就是为您量身打造的。发牌。行动起来吧。提出你的问题。学习新东西。然后比以前更有信心地玩下一手牌。

plugin_asdk_app_6a74401e1c848191874fa2c6.description: 免费塔罗牌和十二生肖占卜
plugin_asdk_app_6a74401e1c848191874fa2c6.productIntro: Evelyn Tarot 将塔罗牌安静、从容的一面带入 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6a74401e1c848191874fa2c6.productIntroEn: Evelyn Tarot brings the quiet, unhurried side of tarot into ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a74401e1c848191874fa2c6.longDescription:
Evelyn Tarot brings the quiet, unhurried side of tarot into ChatGPT.

Draw your card of the day, pull a past-present-future spread for a question you are carrying, or look up any of the 78 tarot cards and read what it means upright and reversed. Beyond the cards, check this week's reading for your zodiac sign, compare the compatibility of two signs, see the current moon phase and its message, calculate your numerology life path number, or find the meaning behind a repeating angel number.

Everything is free, nothing requires an account, and every tool works in ten languages — English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, French, Japanese, Hindi and Indonesian.

These readings are offered for reflection and entertainment. They are not medical, legal or financial advice, and no outcome is guaranteed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a74401e1c848191874fa2c6.longDescriptionZh:
Evelyn Tarot 将塔罗牌安静、从容的一面带入 ChatGPT。

抽出当天的牌，针对您提出的问题抽出过去现在未来的图，或者查找 78 张塔罗牌中的任何一张，并解读其正向和逆向的含义。除了卡片之外，还可以检查本周的星座解读，比较两个星座的兼容性，查看当前的月相及其信息，计算你的命理学生命路径数字，或者找到重复天使数字背后的含义。

一切都是免费的，不需要帐户，每个工具都支持十种语言——英语、土耳其语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、阿拉伯语、法语、日语、印地语和印度尼西亚语。

这些读物供反思和娱乐。它们不是医疗、法律或财务建议，也不保证结果。

[About ABEMA, the Original TV, Drama, and Video Streaming Service]
ABEMA is a video streaming service aiming to innovate television and develop it as "the new future of television." No registration is required, and it broadcasts approximately 30 channels across a wide variety of genres, including a 24-hour news channel, original dramas, romance reality shows, anime, and sports, 24/7, 365 days a year.

ABEMA boasts the largest number of original episodes of any domestic video service in Japan (*1), and offers a wide selection of programs, including popular anime and dramas from Japan and abroad, as well as a variety of music and live stage performances. Enjoy content anytime, anywhere, on TV and on-demand, and watch programs on your smartphone, PC, tablet, or TV device, tailored to your lifestyle and location. (*1) As of April 2025 (based on company research).

plugin_asdk_app_69bf076444388191b92e9c48.longDescription:
Savecraft connects your actual game save data to ChatGPT. Instead of describing your character, gear, and progress from memory, Savecraft reads your real save files and game API profiles so the AI can give you specific, personalized advice.

Ask about your build, compare your gear to a guide, check drop rates with exact math, or just talk about your run: ChatGPT already knows your character. Attach notes like build guides or farming checklists, and the AI can track your progress against them over time.

Premade expert reference modules use your save data to coach you. Draft advisors, drop calculators, crop planners, all grounded in real math.

Follow every baseball game without leaving ChatGPT. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a3d09aa4881919254241e.productIntro: No Bike No Life 使用 NBNL 目录中的数据回答摩托车问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a3d09aa4881919254241e.productIntroEn: No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a3d09aa4881919254241e.longDescription:
No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.

Kaufberatung: Ein Dialog aus neun Fragen zu Nutzung, Erfahrung, Führerschein, Körpergröße und Budget führt zu passenden Modellen — mit Bild, Eckdaten und Begründung, warum ein Motorrad passt.

Katalog: Modelle suchen, Details ansehen, bis zu fünf Maschinen in einer Tabelle vergleichen.

Routen: Strecken zwischen zwei Punkten oder Rundtouren planen, mit Kurvigkeit, Höhenprofil und dem Wetter entlang der Route auf der Karte.

Wetter: Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung, Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass, der zeigt, in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt.

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis.

Alle Angaben stammen aus dem redaktionell gepflegten Katalog von nbnl.de. Modellfotos sind Herstellermaterial und mit Quelle gekennzeichnet.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a3d09aa4881919254241e.longDescriptionZh:
No Bike No Life 使用 NBNL 目录中的数据回答摩托车问题。

购买建议：由有关使用情况、经验、驾驶执照、车身尺寸和预算的九个问题组成的对话会引导您找到合适的车型 - 附有图片、关键数据以及摩托车适合的原因。

目录：搜索型号、查看详细信息、在表格中比较最多五台机器。

路线：规划两点之间的路线或环形游览，并在地图上显示沿线的曲率、海拔剖面和天气。

天气：多日天气预报，包括驾驶性能评估、阿尔卑斯山口的状况以及显示今天值得前往哪个方向的指南针。

初学者知识：超过200个初学者关于技术、维护和驾驶体验的问题解答。

所有信息均来自 nbnl.de 编辑维护的目录。模型照片是制造商材料并标有来源。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5e7246954c81918bd8285f.longDescription:
Get NHL scores, schedules, standings, team details, player information, and game updates without leaving your chat. This app brings hockey information right into your conversation. Ask a question in plain English and get a clear answer. You do not need to search many websites or open another app. Everything stays in one place, making it fast and easy to follow the NHL.

Want today’s scores? Just ask. Want tonight’s games? Ask that too. Need the latest standings? The app can show them. You can check team records, player stats, game times, and much more. If you want to know who won, who is playing next, or how your favorite team is doing, simply ask.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside ChatGPT. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a71cd90a56481919fa672db.description: 寻找安静的迪士尼乐园时光
plugin_asdk_app_6a71cd90a56481919fa672db.productIntro: 魔法提示变成“我们什么时候去？”变成具体的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a71cd90a56481919fa672db.productIntroEn: Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71cd90a56481919fa672db.longDescription:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71cd90a56481919fa672db.longDescriptionZh:
魔法提示变成“我们什么时候去？”变成具体的答案。

询问一个度假村和一个月，您会得到每日人群评分从 1 到 10
巴黎迪士尼乐园各个日期的预计等待时间水平，
华特迪士尼世界、迪士尼乐园度假区（加利福尼亚州）、东京迪士尼度假区、
香港迪士尼乐园和上海迪士尼度假区。分数是由
历史等待时间观察、学校和公共假期日历、
天气数据和季节性事件，然后根据每个公园自己的数据进行标准化
需求范围。

它还回答了接下来的问题：
• 每个公园的景点目录 - 最低高度、游乐时间、必做之事
  旗帜和社区评级
• 在每个度假村搜索哪些餐厅提供特定菜肴
  （“素食主义者”、“火鸡腿”、“米奇华夫饼”）
• 度假村常见问题解答和规划术语的通俗易懂的词汇表（闪电
  Lane、DAS、绳索下降），提供 13 种语言版本

范围和限制，明确说明：覆盖范围为迪士尼乐园和迪士尼
邮轮公司——不是环球公司。景点目录是静态的，并且
不包括实时等待时间或乘车关闭时间。人群分数是预测，
不提供保证；该方法及其已知限制发布于
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips 是一个独立的、由粉丝制作的项目。它不隶属于，
由华特迪士尼公司认可、赞助或正式关联
公司或其任何子公司或附属公司。公园、景点和
角色名称是其各自所有者的商标并被使用
这里只是为了确定该工具涵盖的位置。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84a4f2dc2c81919cc136a2.productIntro: 询问你的出生图，你会得到它，而不仅仅是描述。给出出生日期、时间和地点，AstroBella 占星学会构建完整的本命盘和一个您可以实际探索的轮子 - 单击任何行星以查看其确切的度数、它所在的星座和宫位以及它所形成的每个相位。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84a4f2dc2c81919cc136a2.productIntroEn: Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84a4f2dc2c81919cc136a2.longDescription:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84a4f2dc2c81919cc136a2.longDescriptionZh:
询问你的出生图，你会得到它，而不仅仅是描述。给出出生日期、时间和地点，AstroBella 占星学会构建完整的本命盘和一个您可以实际探索的轮子 - 单击任何行星以查看其确切的度数、它所在的星座和宫位以及它所形成的每个相位。

您可以要求什么：

• 你的本命盘——每一个位置、你的上升星座和中天、宫位和完整的相位列表，旁边画着轮子。

• 现在正在发生的事情——当前触及你星盘的行运，或者扫描未来几周和几个月，显示每个行运达到顶峰的确切日期以及它持续有效的时间。

• 您和其他人— 兼容性比较，列出两个图表之间的所有联系，最接近的在前。

• 快速天空问题——水星是否逆行、月亮在哪个星座、下一次满月是什么时候。这些根本不需要出生细节。

如果您不知道自己的出生时间，您仍然可以获得一张图表。该应用程序会告诉您没有它就无法确定哪些部分——上升星座、中天和宫位——而不是静静地猜测它们。

出生地与超过 120,000 个城镇的内置列表相匹配，因此小家乡和首都一样有效。当一个名字被真诚地分享时——斯普林菲尔德或安大略省的伦敦——你会被问到你指的是哪一个，而不是被猜测。

行星按其真实度数放置，而不是四舍五入为星座，并且当您要求时，每张图表都是根据天文数据新鲜计算出来的。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8ae12a5da881919a205f71.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或创建其他帐户，即可与 AI 进行完整的五子棋游戏。立即在官方 15×15 锦标赛棋盘上开始，选择黑色或白色，并使用简单、普通或困难 AI 来匹配您的技能。您还可以要求快速的 13×13 游戏或宽敞的 19×19 棋盘。选择标准五子棋、自由式五连棋或专业连珠规则以及黑方的上线、双四和双三禁棋。 Pro 和 Long Pro 开局可用于削弱黑棋的先手优势。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ae12a5da881919a205f71.productIntroEn: Play a complete game of Gomoku against AI without leaving ChatGPT or creating another account. Start instantly on the official 15×15 tournament board, choose Black or White, and match your skill with Easy, Normal, or Hard AI. You can also request a quick 13×13 game or a spacious 19×19 board.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ae12a5da881919a205f71.longDescription: Play a complete game of Gomoku against AI without leaving ChatGPT or creating another account. Start instantly on the official 15×15 tournament board, choose Black or White, and match your skill with Easy, Normal, or Hard AI. You can also request a quick 13×13 game or a spacious 19×19 board. Pick Standard Gomoku, Freestyle Five in a Row, or professional Renju rules with Black’s overline, double-four, and double-three forbidden moves. Pro and Long Pro openings are available to reduce Black’s first-move advantage. The interactive board marks forbidden points, highlights the latest stone, displays move numbers, and warns when your opponent can win on the next turn. Two-tap move confirmation helps prevent mistakes on mobile, while undo and resign keep the game flexible. After the final move, the winning five and result appear immediately. Whether you call it Gomoku, Five in a Row, Renju, Omok, or Gobang, this is a fast, polished way to challenge an AI at your level.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3562e174819198170880.name: Leela Online
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3562e174819198170880.productIntro: 你生活中的某些东西不断地回到同一个地方——同样的争论，同样的你已经不再需要的工作，同样的带着每个人却被忽视的感觉。你知道循环。你无法从里面看到它。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3562e174819198170880.productIntroEn: Something in your life keeps coming back to the same place — the same argument, the same work you have outgrown, the same feeling of carrying everyone and being unseen. You know the loop. You cannot see it from inside it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3562e174819198170880.longDescription:
Something in your life keeps coming back to the same place — the same argument, the same work you have outgrown, the same feeling of carrying everyone and being unseen. You know the loop. You cannot see it from inside it.

Leela opens a board in this chat and puts a Guide beside you. First the Guide helps you say the one question you actually came with, not the polished version of it. Then you throw the die once, and the square you land on answers a piece of that question — in your own words, not a horoscope.

Leela (Gyan Chauper) is a real Indian game of self-knowledge: seventy-two squares with snakes and arrows, played for centuries before it travelled west and became Snakes and Ladders. The full walk across all seventy-two, with the Guide on every square, continues on the site.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3562e174819198170880.longDescriptionZh:
你生活中的某些东西不断地回到同一个地方——同样的争论，同样的你已经不再需要的工作，同样的带着每个人却被忽视的感觉。你知道循环。你无法从里面看到它。

Leela 在此聊天中打开一个图板，并将指南放在您旁边。首先，指南帮助您说出您实际提出的一个问题，而不是它的完美版本。然后你扔一次骰子，你落在的方格就回答了这个问题的一部分——用你自己的话说，不是星座运势。

Leela（Gyan Chauper 饰）是一种真正的印度自我认识游戏：有七十二个方格的蛇和箭，在它向西传播并成为《蛇与梯》之前已经玩了几个世纪。整个七十二个广场的完整步行仍在现场继续进行，每个广场上都有指南。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7295ec7ba081919f0d1940.productIntro: 罗文让你的助手策划你听的内容。向 ChatGPT 询问任何事情——“我通勤的一小时芯片大战，包括一个怀疑的镜头”——它会制定一个准备播放的计划：每一集都根据 Rovyn 的目录（可播放，或诚实地报告为什么不播放），一个点击播放链接，在 Rovyn iOS 播放器中的每个选择下都有一行“为什么”。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7295ec7ba081919f0d1940.productIntroEn: Rovyn lets your assistant curate what you listen to. Ask ChatGPT for anything — "an hour on the chip war for my commute, one skeptical take included" — and it builds a ready-to-play plan: every episode grounded against Rovyn's catalog (playable, or honestly reported why not), one tap-to-play link, a one-line "why" under each pick in the Rovyn iOS player.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7295ec7ba081919f0d1940.longDescription:
Rovyn lets your assistant curate what you listen to. Ask ChatGPT for anything — "an hour on the chip war for my commute, one skeptical take included" — and it builds a ready-to-play plan: every episode grounded against Rovyn's catalog (playable, or honestly reported why not), one tap-to-play link, a one-line "why" under each pick in the Rovyn iOS player.

The loop closes after you listen. ChatGPT reads compact receipts — what you finished, what you dropped, and anything you wrote in your own words — so the next plan starts from what the last one actually did.

The exchange is scoped by design: ChatGPT sends a brief (goal, time, level), Rovyn returns receipts. Each assistant connects with its own revocable grant, speaking Cueback, an open MCP convention.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7295ec7ba081919f0d1940.longDescriptionZh:
罗文让你的助手策划你听的内容。向 ChatGPT 询问任何事情——“我通勤的一小时芯片大战，包括一个怀疑的镜头”——它会制定一个准备播放的计划：每一集都根据 Rovyn 的目录（可播放，或诚实地报告为什么不播放），一个点击播放链接，在 Rovyn iOS 播放器中的每个选择下都有一行“为什么”。

听完后循环结束。 ChatGPT 读取紧凑的收据——你完成了什么，你放弃了什么，以及你用自己的话写的任何东西——所以下一个计划从上一个实际做了的事情开始。

交换的范围是按设计确定的：ChatGPT 发送摘要（目标、时间、级别），Rovyn 返回收据。每个助手都通过 Cueback（一种开放的 MCP 约定）连接自己的可撤销授权。

plugin_asdk_app_6a509b9c8878819190467d40.longDescription:
Sena.lt

Vintage & secondhand marketplace

Search more than 500,000 listings on Lithuania's marketplace for preloved, vintage and out-of-print finds — rare books and first editions, collectible vinyl records, retro board games, and one-of-a-kind home and interior pieces.

Ask in plain language for a title, an author, an artist, a genre or an era. Narrow results by price, publication year, language, category and item type, or sort by cheapest first. Open any listing to see its condition, photos, seller and description, and ask for more listings like it.

Every result comes back with a direct link to the listing on sena.lt, where you contact the seller and complete the purchase.

Sena searches the public catalogue only. It does not sign you in, post or edit listings, or read your account.

Sena helps you give things a second life — resale made simple, sustainable and local.
plugin_asdk_app_6a509b9c8878819190467d40.longDescriptionZh:
参议员

古董和二手市场

在立陶宛市场上搜索超过 500,000 个商品，寻找二手、古董和绝版物品 - 珍本书籍和第一版、可收藏的黑胶唱片、复古棋盘游戏以及独一无二的家居和室内装饰。

用通俗易懂的语言询问标题、作者、艺术家、流派或时代。按价格、出版年份、语言、类别和商品类型缩小搜索范围，或按最便宜的优先排序。打开任何列表即可查看其状况、照片、卖家和描述，并询问更多类似的列表。

每个结果都会返回一个直接链接到 sena.lt 上的列表，您可以在其中联系卖家并完成购买。

Sena 仅搜索公共目录。它不会让您登录、发布或编辑列表或读取您的帐户。

Sena 帮助您赋予物品第二次生命 - 转售变得简单、可持续且本地化。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.name: Interestnaut
plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.originalDescription: Find what to watch, read, play
plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.productIntro: Interestnaut 根据您对电影、电视、书籍、游戏、音乐、播客和创作者的实际反应和评分进行推荐，而不是根据流派标签进行猜测。 ChatGPT 可以读取您的反应历史记录、您的 1-10 评分和计算出的品味概况，并按标题在所有七种媒体类型中搜索目录。评分传达的信号最多：它们稀疏且经过深思熟虑，因此 9 的含义远高于“喜欢”。反应也不能互换——“meh”意味着你吃了一些东西但没有任何感觉，而“skipped”意味着你没有参与并且没有任何意见。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.productIntroEn: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.longDescription: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types. Ratings carry the most signal: they are sparse and deliberate, so a 9 means considerably more than a like. Reactions are not interchangeable either — "meh" means you consumed something and felt nothing, while "skipped" means you passed without engaging and carries no opinion at all. With your permission it can also record reactions and ratings, so you can keep your library current without leaving the conversation. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and a consent screen listing exactly what you are granting, and you can disconnect at any time. Results render as interactive cards showing cover art, with one-tap buttons that record a reaction or save something for later without leaving the conversation. Plot summaries and adult titles are never sent, and every card links back to app.interestnaut.com. Nothing here is locked to this conversation. Everything ChatGPT reads or writes is your own Interestnaut account, and the same library is open in the app on the web, iPhone and Android — where you can review what was saved, change or remove any reaction, add things ChatGPT never saw, build lists, and watch your taste profile update. Ratings are recorded through the assistant and feed the same taste profile. Start something here and finish it there, or the other way round; the account is the same either way, and it outlives this connection.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8246417f0c8191acf85a7f.longDescriptionZh: Interestnaut 根据您对电影、电视、书籍、游戏、音乐、播客和创作者的实际反应和评分进行推荐，而不是根据流派标签进行猜测。 ChatGPT 可以读取您的反应历史记录、您的 1-10 评分和计算出的品味概况，并按标题在所有七种媒体类型中搜索目录。评分传达的信号最多：它们稀疏且经过深思熟虑，因此 9 的含义远高于“喜欢”。反应也不能互换——“meh”意味着你吃了一些东西但没有任何感觉，而“skipped”意味着你没有参与并且没有任何意见。在您的许可下，它还可以记录反应和评分，这样您就可以在不离开对话的情况下使您的库保持最新状态。登录是使用 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1 和一个同意屏幕，其中列出了您所授予的内容，并且您可以随时断开连接。结果呈现为显示封面艺术的交互式卡片，通过一键式按钮记录反应或保存某些内容以供以后使用，而无需离开对话。情节摘要和成人标题永远不会发送，每张卡片都会链接回 app.interestnaut.com。这里没有任何内容与这次谈话有关。 ChatGPT 读取或写入的所有内容都是您自己的 Interestnaut 帐户，并且在网络、iPhone 和 Android 上的应用程序中打开同一个库 - 您可以在其中查看保存的内容、更改或删除任何反应、添加 ChatGPT 从未见过的内容、构建列表并观看您的品味配置文件更新。评分是通过助手记录的，并提供相同的口味配置文件。在这里开始做某事，在那里完成它，或者反之亦然；无论哪种方式，帐户都是相同的，并且它的寿命会超过此连接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a842718e9ac8191a55f4244.longDescription:
Pixmoto is where you find recipe videos built for the moment you're deciding what to cook. However you search, whether by dish, cuisine, ingredient, dietary need, or the occasion itself, Pixmoto surfaces interactive recipe experiences that pair video with synchronised step-by-step method and full ingredient lists, so you can follow along at your own pace while you watch.

Whether you know exactly what you want or need inspiration to decide, Pixmoto turns the "what should I cook?" moment into a dish you can actually make.

plugin_asdk_app_69a0c7a3e4908191b99fe7cb.productIntroEn: Grid Pulse is a 6×6 logic puzzle — fill the grid so every row and column contains 1–6 exactly once, a Sudoku variant without the 3×3 blocks.
plugin_asdk_app_69a0c7a3e4908191b99fe7cb.longDescription:
Grid Pulse is a 6×6 logic puzzle — fill the grid so every row and column contains 1–6 exactly once, a Sudoku variant without the 3×3 blocks.

Choose Daily mode to play the same puzzle as everyone else and compare your score, or Free Play for an infinite variety of grids. Three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) with pressure tiles: countdown cells that penalize you if left empty too long.

Score is based on speed and accuracy. Earn medals from Bronze to Perfect.
plugin_asdk_app_69a0c7a3e4908191b99fe7cb.longDescriptionZh:

选择“每日”模式与其他人一样玩相同的谜题并比较您的分数，或者选择“免费游戏”以获取无限多种网格。三个难度级别（简单、中等、困难），带有压力图块：倒计时单元格如果空得太久就会对你造成惩罚。

分数基于速度和准确性。获得从铜牌到完美的奖牌。

plugin_asdk_app_6a91e12001688191808d42f8.longDescription:
Quilty lets ChatGPT read the completed screenplay analyses you already own on quilty.app.

All tools are read-only. The plugin cannot upload scripts, start analyses, change settings, or spend credits. It only sees analyses on the Quilty account you sign in with.

plugin_asdk_app_6a91e12001688191808d42f8.longDescriptionZh:

所有工具都是只读的。该插件无法上传脚本、开始分析、更改设置或花费积分。它只会看到对您登录的 Quilty 帐户的分析。

Quilty Score 是对上传文本的诊断评估，而不是对票房或商业结果的预测。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c5f87e3648191840c0b30.description: 在钢琴卷轴中共同创作
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c5f87e3648191840c0b30.productIntro: VeyrPiano 在 ChatGPT 内为用户提供了交互式钢琴卷帘，用于创建和继续共享的音乐作品。用户可以绘制、移动、调整大小、试听、删除、撤消和重做音符；调整延音和节奏；并将该作品交给 ChatGPT，以获得一个有限的附加音乐动作。人工创建的注释显示为绿色，而 ChatGPT 创建的注释显示为蓝色，随着作品的发展，保留了可见的作者身份。活动组合可以稍后明确地重新打开，并从其最新的权威状态继续。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c5f87e3648191840c0b30.productIntroEn: VeyrPiano gives users an interactive piano roll inside ChatGPT for creating and continuing shared musical compositions. Users can draw, move, resize, audition, remove, undo, and redo notes; adjust sustain and tempo; and hand the piece to ChatGPT for one bounded additive musical move.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c5f87e3648191840c0b30.longDescription: VeyrPiano gives users an interactive piano roll inside ChatGPT for creating and continuing shared musical compositions. Users can draw, move, resize, audition, remove, undo, and redo notes; adjust sustain and tempo; and hand the piece to ChatGPT for one bounded additive musical move. Human-created notes appear green and ChatGPT-created notes appear blue, preserving visible authorship as the piece develops. An active composition can be explicitly reopened later and continued from its latest authoritative state.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.description: 在 ChatGPT 中与 AI 下围棋
plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.originalDescription: Play Go with AI in ChatGPT
plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.productIntro: 走吧！让您可以直接在 ChatGPT 内与 AI 进行围棋比赛，无需单独登录。游戏默认使用专业和国际锦标赛标准 19×19 棋盘，当您要求更短的比赛时，也可以使用 13×13 和 9×9 棋盘。选择玩黑棋或白棋，从三个 AI 难度级别中进行选择，并在您想要平衡游戏时使用 2 到 9 颗棋子的让分。去！处理合法的移动放置和捕获，同时强制禁止自杀、KO 和重复位置。在游戏过程中，你可以放弃、放弃或撤销一步。比赛结束后，采用中国区计分法对棋盘进行计分。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.productIntroEn: Go! lets you play Go against AI directly inside ChatGPT, with no separate login required. Games use the professional and international tournament standard 19×19 board by default, while 13×13 and 9×9 boards are available whenever you request a shorter match.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.longDescription: Go! lets you play Go against AI directly inside ChatGPT, with no separate login required. Games use the professional and international tournament standard 19×19 board by default, while 13×13 and 9×9 boards are available whenever you request a shorter match. Choose to play Black or White, select from three AI difficulty levels, and use a handicap of 2 to 9 stones when you want to balance the game. Go! handles legal move placement and captures while enforcing the prohibition on suicide, ko, and repeated positions. During a game, you can pass, resign, or undo a move. When play ends, the board is scored using Chinese area scoring. The result clearly identifies the winner and uses standard notation such as B+12.5 or W+R. A detailed breakdown shows stones, territory, komi, and totals, with territory marked directly on the board so you can understand how the result was calculated. The complete interface is presented in English. Whether you search for Go, Baduk, Weiqi, or simply want to play Go without leaving ChatGPT, Go! provides a convenient, rules-aware way to start a match at your preferred board size and difficulty.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8add013f68819180b6717a.longDescriptionZh: 走吧！让您可以直接在 ChatGPT 内与 AI 进行围棋比赛，无需单独登录。游戏默认使用专业和国际锦标赛标准 19×19 棋盘，当您要求更短的比赛时，也可以使用 13×13 和 9×9 棋盘。选择玩黑棋或白棋，从三个 AI 难度级别中进行选择，并在您想要平衡游戏时使用 2 到 9 颗棋子的让分。去！处理合法的移动放置和捕获，同时强制禁止自杀、KO 和重复位置。在游戏过程中，你可以放弃、放弃或撤销一步。比赛结束后，采用中国区计分法对棋盘进行计分。结果清楚地标识了获胜者并使用标准符号，例如 B+12.5 或 W+R。详细的分类显示了棋子、领地、科米和总数，领地直接标记在棋盘上，以便您了解结果是如何计算的。完整的界面以英文显示。无论您是搜索围棋、围棋、围棋，还是只是想在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下玩围棋，Go!提供了一种方便、熟悉规则的方式，以您喜欢的棋盘尺寸和难度开始比赛。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8bc95cafc08191a19ad8e5.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中与 AI 下象棋。选择红色或黑色，选择简单、普通或困难，然后在标准 9×10 棋盘上玩完整的游戏。合法走法突出显示、检查警报、捕获棋子、撤消、放弃以及繁体中文和 WXF 走法符号使每个回合都易于遵循。比赛遵循国际象棋规则，包括飞一般规则、将死、无合法步子失败、重复和永久检查规则以及60步不吃棋等规则。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bc95cafc08191a19ad8e5.productIntroEn: Play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) against AI directly in ChatGPT. Choose Red or Black, select Easy, Normal, or Hard, and play a complete game on a standard 9×10 board. Legal-move highlights, check alerts, captured pieces, undo, resign, and traditional Chinese and WXF move notation make every turn easy to follow.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bc95cafc08191a19ad8e5.longDescription: Play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) against AI directly in ChatGPT. Choose Red or Black, select Easy, Normal, or Hard, and play a complete game on a standard 9×10 board. Legal-move highlights, check alerts, captured pieces, undo, resign, and traditional Chinese and WXF move notation make every turn easy to follow. Games follow international Xiangqi rules, including the flying-general rule, checkmate, loss when no legal move remains, repetition and perpetual-check rulings, and the 60-move no-capture draw.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b1ebe49588191a38ff221.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中玩新鲜的数独谜题。选择一个级别并立即使用屏幕数字键盘或键盘开始解决问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b1ebe49588191a38ff221.productIntroEn: Play fresh Sudoku puzzles directly in ChatGPT. Choose a level and start solving instantly with the on-screen number pad or your keyboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b1ebe49588191a38ff221.longDescription:
Play fresh Sudoku puzzles directly in ChatGPT. Choose a level and start solving instantly with the on-screen number pad or your keyboard.

Every puzzle is freshly generated with exactly one solution. Five carefully graded difficulty levels welcome every kind of solver: Easy builds confidence, Medium develops technique, Hard raises the challenge, Expert rewards experienced players, and Master offers the deepest test. Each level is measured by the solving logic the puzzle actually requires.

Designed for smooth, satisfying play:
• Instant feedback makes every entry easy to review.
• Pencil marks, erase, and unlimited undo keep every move flexible.
• Logic-based hints guide your next step and help you learn.
• A timer, progress bar, and live remaining-number counts keep you in flow.
• Tap any number to highlight every matching cell on the board.

Choose the classic 9x9 Sudoku, a quick 4x4 or 6x6 puzzle, or the ultimate 16x16 Hexadoku with symbols 1-9 and A-G.

Enjoy a quick mental break, daily brain training, or a serious solving challenge whenever you want. Available in twelve languages.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b1ebe49588191a38ff221.longDescriptionZh:
直接在 ChatGPT 中玩新鲜的数独谜题。选择一个级别并立即使用屏幕数字键盘或键盘开始解决问题。

每个谜题都是用完全相同的一个解决方案新鲜生成的。五个精心分级的难度级别欢迎各种解决者：简单建立信心，中等发展技术，困难提高挑战，专家奖励经验丰富的玩家，大师提供最深入的测试。每个级别都是根据谜题实际需要的解决逻辑来衡量的。

专为流畅、令人满意的游戏而设计：
• 即时反馈使每个条目都易于审核。
• 铅笔标记、擦除和无限撤消使每一个动作都变得灵活。
• 基于逻辑的提示指导您的下一步并帮助您学习。
• 计时器、进度条和实时剩余号码计数让您保持流畅。
• 点击任意数字可突出显示板上每个匹配的单元格。

选择经典的 9x9 数独、快速 4x4 或 6x6 拼图，或带有符号 1-9 和 A-G 的终极 16x16 六独。

随时享受快速的精神休息、日常大脑训练或严肃的解决挑战。有十二种语言版本。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60b9b69b688191bc2bbccb.name: Playfrog
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b9b69b688191bc2bbccb.productIntro: Playfrog 准备从 ChatGPT 发布浏览器游戏。它接受静态 HTML5 和 JavaScript 文件并存储未发布的草稿，而无需创建可玩的页面或游戏服务路径。观看页面和游戏源返回 404，并且该工具返回声明链接，但没有播放 URL 或管理令牌。草稿只能在创建草稿的连接器会话中进行修改。该服务器上没有工具发布游戏。在 Playfrog 创建公共服务路径之前，用户必须打开声明链接、登录 Playfrog 并完成发布。未发布的草稿将在 7 天后删除。
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b9b69b688191bc2bbccb.productIntroEn: Playfrog prepares browser games for publishing from ChatGPT. It accepts static HTML5 and JavaScript files and stores an unpublished draft without creating a playable page or game-serving route. The watch page and game origin return 404, and the tool returns a claim link but no play URL or manage token. A draft can be revised only in the connector session that created it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b9b69b688191bc2bbccb.longDescription: Playfrog prepares browser games for publishing from ChatGPT. It accepts static HTML5 and JavaScript files and stores an unpublished draft without creating a playable page or game-serving route. The watch page and game origin return 404, and the tool returns a claim link but no play URL or manage token. A draft can be revised only in the connector session that created it. No tool on this server publishes a game. A person must open the claim link, sign in to Playfrog, and finish publishing before Playfrog creates a public serving path. Unpublished drafts are deleted after seven days.

plugin_asdk_app_69a97eaa96a08191b6d20571.description: 使用 AI 解读生辰八字。
plugin_asdk_app_69a97eaa96a08191b6d20571.productIntro: Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) 将古老的韩国艺术 Saju（命运的四大支柱）带到 ChatGPT，由来自首尔最负盛名的地区的 20 多位算命大师训练的专有人工智能提供支持。
plugin_asdk_app_69a97eaa96a08191b6d20571.productIntroEn: Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) brings the ancient Korean art of Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) to ChatGPT, powered by proprietary AI trained with over 20 master fortune tellers from Seoul's most prestigious districts.
plugin_asdk_app_69a97eaa96a08191b6d20571.longDescription:
Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) brings the ancient Korean art of Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) to ChatGPT, powered by proprietary AI trained with over 20 master fortune tellers from Seoul's most prestigious districts.

Simply share your birth date, time, and gender, and instantly receive a professionally analyzed birth chart — including your Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements distribution, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual Fortune forecasts (세운), all visualized in a clean, interactive card.

Trusted by over 1 million monthly users, Saju DoctorFortune is the world's leading AI-powered Saju service. Every reading is grounded in authentic Myeongrihak (명리학) principles, delivering the same depth and accuracy you'd expect from a top-tier in-person consultation — but available anytime, right inside your conversation.

Whether you're curious about career timing, relationship compatibility, or what the year ahead holds, ask ChatGPT with Saju DoctorFortune and get clear, honest insights rooted in centuries of Korean fortune-telling tradition.
plugin_asdk_app_69a97eaa96a08191b6d20571.longDescriptionZh:
Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) 将古老的韩国艺术 Saju（命运的四大支柱）带到 ChatGPT，由来自首尔最负盛名的地区的 20 多位算命大师训练的专有人工智能提供支持。

只需分享您的出生日期、时间和性别，即可立即收到经过专业分析的出生图 - 包括您的四大支柱 (사주팔자)、五行分布、主要财富周期 (대운) 和年度财富预测 (세운)，所有这些都以干净的交互式卡片的形式呈现。

Saju DoctorFortune 是全球领先的人工智能驱动的 Saju 服务，深受每月超过 100 万用户的信赖。每一篇阅读都基于真实的明里学 (명리학) 原则，提供与顶级面对面咨询相同的深度和准确性 - 但可以随时在您的对话中使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5844ea64f48191930701ae.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.

每个解读都将信号与问题联系起来，区分反思与预测，并提供实际的 7 天行动以及健康、财务、法律和其他重要主题的明确界限。用户可以选择保存一张 JPEG 卡来保存他们绘制的确切标志。该服务仅处理返回读数所需的输入，并且不会保留仪式会话。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84603f469c8191b16d5572.longDescription:
Tarot by DoctorFortune is a free AI tarot reading experience where you draw your own cards and discover what they reveal. It uses the complete 78-card Rider–Waite deck, including both the Major and Minor Arcana, and offers focused one-card readings or three-card spreads that explore the past, present, future, and the overall direction of your situation.

Hold your question in mind and choose your cards for insights into love, reconciliation, someone’s true feelings, dating, compatibility, new relationships, career decisions, job changes, personal relationships, or your daily fortune. Each reading considers the cards’ upright or reversed meanings, their positions in the spread, and how they interact—connecting the full story to clear, practical next steps.

DoctorFortune brings every reading to life with a bright, witty, and refreshingly honest personality. Positive cards are celebrated, while challenging cards are explained directly without sugarcoating. Even unfamiliar tarot concepts are translated into clear, approachable language, creating a reading that feels personal, vivid, and relevant to your question.

Whether you are looking for free AI tarot, ChatGPT tarot, love tarot, reconciliation tarot, compatibility tarot, feelings tarot, career guidance, daily tarot, or one-card and three-card readings, Tarot by DoctorFortune lets you choose the cards yourself and enjoy a more engaging tarot experience. Korean is the primary language, with support for English, Japanese, Chinese, and more. 🃏✨
plugin_asdk_app_6a84603f469c8191b16d5572.longDescriptionZh:
DoctorFortune 的塔罗牌是一种免费的人工智能塔罗牌阅读体验，您可以绘制自己的牌并发现它们揭示的内容。它使用完整的 78 张 Rider-Waite 牌组，包括大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，并提供集中的一张牌解读或三张牌展开，探索过去、现在、未来以及您处境的总体方向。

plugin_asdk_app_6a85aabb74f48191a4071b15.productIntro: 免费的人工智能占星学可以进行真正的数学计算。给出您的出生日期、时间和城市，占星学财富博士会找到您的星座并绘制完整的出生图 - 太阳、月亮和上升，所有十颗行星，十二宫和每个主要相位 - 在交互式图表轮上，您可以在聊天中探索。
plugin_asdk_app_6a85aabb74f48191a4071b15.productIntroEn: Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a85aabb74f48191a4071b15.longDescription:
Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. Horoscope: today's, this week's or any date's planetary transits read against your own chart instead of a generic sun-sign column. Compatibility: two charts overlaid for a synastry reading with mutual aspects, a match score and house overlays.

Positions are computed on the server from VSOP87D and ELP-2000 ephemeris data — the same astronomy professional astrology software runs on — with time zone and longitude correction applied automatically. Birth cities work in any language or script: Seoul or 서울, Hanoi or Hà Nội, Munich or München. Readings and chart labels come in 12 languages, including English, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Arabic and Vietnamese. No account, no setup, and it still works when you don't know your birth time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a85aabb74f48191a4071b15.longDescriptionZh:
免费的人工智能占星学可以进行真正的数学计算。给出您的出生日期、时间和城市，占星学财富博士会找到您的星座并绘制完整的出生图 - 太阳、月亮和上升，所有十颗行星，十二宫和每个主要相位 - 在交互式图表轮上，您可以在聊天中探索。

一个应用程序中的三个读数。本命盘：你的十二生肖位置反映了你的个性、优势和盲点。星座运势：今天、本周或任何日期的行星过境是根据您自己的星盘而不是通用的太阳星座栏来读取的。兼容性：两张图表重叠在一起，可以进行具有相互方面、比赛得分和房屋叠加的联盘解读。

位置是在服务器上根据 VSOP87D 和 ELP-2000 星历数据（运行相同的天文学专业占星软件）计算出来的，并自动应用时区和经度校正。出生城市可以使用任何语言或文字：首尔或서울、河内或河内、慕尼黑或慕尼黑。读数和图表标签有 12 种语言版本，包括英语、韩语、繁体中文和简体中文、日语、印地语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、德语、法语、阿拉伯语和越南语。无需帐户，无需设置，即使您不知道自己的出生时间，它仍然有效。
